source_request: 은꼴사에 초점을 맞춰서 컨셉 만들어서 다시 한번 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create and independently test a photographic concept whose focal effect is understated, non-explicit suggestiveness arising from an ordinary adult fashion-adjustment moment, with the visual cause readable rather than implied by a label.
subject: One unmistakably adult woman with visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture, wearing a constructed opaque foundation garment beneath a separate tailored outer garment.
setting: A late-night independent boutique fitting salon between appointments, beside a transparent acrylic garment screen crossed by one reflected ceiling strip.
event: Paused mid-adjustment, she lifts one exact waist-height corner of her jacket's left front edge; that hand movement opens a narrow diagonal waist interval while both garments remain visibly distinct.
visual_priorities: The face and the hand-altered jacket boundary must be the first two thumbnail reads.
The hand, exact outer edge, bounded waist interval, and constructed opaque foundation must form one traceable same-frame causal relation.
The inner and outer garments must remain physically legible as two separate fashion layers through seams, hems, straps, lapels, overlap direction, and contact shadow.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a vertical photorealistic editorial photograph in a late-night independent boutique fitting salon between appointments, built around an ordinary adult fashion-adjustment event with a visible causal boundary change. Show one unmistakably adult woman from head to upper thighs, with visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture. She wears an opaque ivory satin camisole with wide bound straps, a squared neckline, architectural bust seams, and a clearly visible lower hem under a separate midnight-navy linen-silk tailored suit jacket with lapels, front edges, one button, and a clean inner lining. Her right thumb and forefinger lift the precise waist-height corner of the jacket's left front edge to settle its overlap, paused before release. The lifted outer edge changes the clothing boundary in the same frame and reveals a narrow diagonal strip of bare waist between the camisole hem and high-rise trouser waistband. Keep her hand, the exact jacket edge, the changed boundary, the bounded waist interval, and both garment hems visibly connected as one causal relation. Closing that edge would cover the waist interval while the opaque camisole would remain visibly separate at the neckline and lapel opening. Place a transparent acrylic garment screen behind her, crossed by one reflected ceiling strip, while her real face, real hand, and real torso remain traceable. Make her face the first thumbnail focal read and the hand-altered boundary the second. Use diffuse rainy daylight with one warm practical glow, photographed vertically at eye level with a 55 mm lens. Preserve realistic satin sheen, linen-silk grain, seam relief, overlap direction, contact shadow, and natural skin texture.
